scope: Corollary 5.1 (Periodic forcing from time zero) of the manuscript “Universal Computation with Eventually Stationary Navier–Stokes Forcing” (preprints/Universal-Computation-with-Eventually-Stationary-Navier-Stokes-Forcing-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0af659c5a6f8e7b0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is also an effective construction with zero initial velocity on 𝕋3, a smooth mean-zero force of period one in time with all mixed derivatives bounded, and the fixed particle event of Theorem 1.1.
